mapper.sql: r.id AS file_id, r.owner_principal_id, r.original_filename, r.content_type, r.size_bytes, r.status, r.upload_expires_at, r.ready_at, r.consumed_at, r.delete_requested_at, r.deleted_at, r.version, o.provider, o.bucket, o.object_key, o.temporary_object_key
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_file_resource r JOIN sys_file_object o ON o.file_id = r.id WHERE r.id = #{fileId} AND r.deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_file_resource SET status = #{nextStatus}, content_type = #{contentType}, size_bytes = #{sizeBytes}, ready_at = #{at}, updated_at = #{at}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{fileId} AND owner_principal_id = #{ownerPrincipalId} AND status = #{currentStatus} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE sys_file_resource SET status = #{expiredStatus}, delete_requested_at = #{now}, updated_at = #{now}, version = version + 1 WHERE id IN ( SELECT id FROM sys_file_resource WHERE deleted = 0 AND ( (status = #{pendingStatus} AND upload_expires_at <= #{now}) OR (status = #{readyStatus} AND ready_at <= #{readyBefore}) ) ORDER BY updated_at, id LIMIT #{limit} ) AND status IN (#{pendingStatus}, #{readyStatus}) AND deleted = 0
